title: Records description drift blocks the strict tool catalog release gate
surface: Guarded hosted release tool catalog gate
organization_context: Configured member organization supplied by the release gate
preconditions: Hosted release run 39101203775 checks the live tool registry and deployed server Records declaration before publication.
The records tool has 31 matching action variants in the database and deployed declaration.
reproduction: Inspect hosted release run 39101203775 and failure artifact 12126975963: catalog:tools:drift:strict exits 1 before publication.

Compare tool.definition.parameters for records with the authenticated /tools/test/records declared_parameters: exactly three description leaves differ: data_sync.background, notion_sync.background and notion_sync.run_id.
The pre-repair strict gate reports DB action variants differ from canonical generated declaration; the other 83 tool definitions, 83 active bindings and two extension surfaces match.
expected: The live records row matches the deployed generated declaration, and the strict gate passes without relaxing any contract check.
actual: The live row retained older wording for three Records background-job descriptions, while the deployed producer described conversation wake and live progress. The generated SQL artifact was also stale and could reintroduce the old row.
reproducibility: The original hosted gate failed with exit 1. A private authenticated read-only comparison isolated the same three leaves; the post-repair strict gate passes with 83 advertised tools, 83 database definitions, 83 active bindings and two surfaces.
severity: S2: candidate publication blocked by a genuine registry contract mismatch.
priority: P1: align the canonical row and prevent regeneration from stale source.
cause: Records wire descriptions changed in the aidream producer after the live tool.definition row and checked-in generated SQL were last synchronized. The existing generator test compared definition_sql() with itself and could not catch a stale artifact.
sibling_census: All 31 Records action names matched. A full generated-producer versus live-row comparison found only the three named leaf differences; the strict gate found no other advertised tool drift after repair.
reviewer: Independent peer A/B PASS on the live-row repair, generated SQL and corrected forcing test; hosted release retest pending.
acceptance_criteria: Only the three outdated Records description leaves change in the live row; action names, schemas and other parameters remain identical.
The checked-in generated SQL exactly matches the Records producer, and the test fails when that file is stale.
The authenticated strict catalog gate passes, followed by a guarded hosted release retest on synchronized main before closure.

verification.database: One optimistic Management API UPDATE required exact old values, affected one records row, and returned the expected JSONB object. Full before/after comparison and fresh readback showed no other parameter changes.
verification.red: The corrected generator test failed with exit 1 against the stale checked-in SQL, then passed after regeneration.
verification.focused: Two Records contract tests passed, one live-DB fixture deselected; Ruff check and format, git diff --check and generated SQL equality passed.
verification.catalog: Authenticated pnpm -s catalog:tools:drift:strict exited 0: 83 advertised/DB definitions/bindings, two surfaces, no drift.
verification.peer: Independent peer A/B PASS after the forcing-test correction.

limitations: The local authenticated strict gate is not a hosted release result.
The repaired source and row have not yet been verified in a new hosted publication attempt.
next_action: Release owner synchronizes the extension and aidream main checkouts, reruns the strict preflight, then dispatches one guarded hosted release and records its verdict before closing this defect.

transition_history.reason: Hosted run 39101203775 blocked publication on three Records description differences.
Live DB, generated SQL and forcing test repaired; authenticated strict gate and independent peer pass, hosted retest remains pending.
